note: Each painted colour is given a block a full WCAG ten degree window wide, which is larger than the real surfaces, so this overstates the flashing area rather than understating it.
pattern_note: The broadcast pass adds ITU-R BT.1702-3 Guideline 2, which the wcag profile does not carry. These frames hold no text, so it asks whether the layout of the app's own blocks is a regular pattern. What the rule makes of glyphs is measured in results/pattern_text_precision.json.
